answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and isolated to the primary region, which matches memory_b2 (clean regional traffic shift, minutes-scale recovery). Rollback is disallowed by the security-patch constraint, so memory_b1 is not actionable. Circuit breaking (memory_b4) would fail requests and risks losing customer writes. Read-replica routing (memory_b5) treated dashboard reads, not settlement writes. Capacity (memory_b3) was provisioned before a peak, not proven mid-incident, and would not address a region-scoped fault. One intervention only, so failover must be a full traffic shift to restore availability; shifting peak settlement writes still carries secondary-overload/consistency risk, and memory_b2 is unverified for this load shape.
